title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Show the team
hook: A player learned a new skill at home. Do you let them show it?
intro: They have been practicing a slide in the backyard.
They are bursting to show someone.
statement: Showing a skill to peers builds pride and confidence.
q1: Do you give them a minute to show the team —
q2: or keep practice on your plan?
q3: What would it mean to that player?
t1: Every team is different. But kids practice more
t2: when their work gets a moment in front of the team.
cta: Coaches — do players get to show off skills?
ctaLines: Show-and-tell minute. After practice. Not during.
Make time or stick to the plan?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player learned a new skill at home. Do you let them show it?
They have been practicing a slide in the backyard. They are bursting to show someone.
Showing a skill to peers builds pride and confidence.
Make a minute for it or stick to the plan. There is no single right way.
Do players get to show off skills? Share your habit in the comments.
